checks.name: logic_error_explicit
checks.value: Weak perspective readability does not imply insufficient riser amplitude. Lower fragmentation or greater connectedness also does not prove correct topology because an indiscriminate closing can erase legitimate drainage breaks. R40 therefore tests structured same-family junction evidence instead of height amplification or global mask closing.
checks.limit: visibility != riser amplitude; connectivity != topology truth

checks.value: the 6 m organization lattice, neighbour sectors, 12 m hard-core rule and generated junctions are synthetic QA morphology, not surveyed Yunnan terrace branch/merge geometry. Current 12.5 m macro DEM and photographs cannot provide field microtopography, parcel/management boundaries, bund-riser-channel sections, inlet/outlet sill elevations or event water-management records.
